title: Count a letter, now with count()
prompt: Same task with the built-in count method.
signature: func solve(text: String, letter: String) -> int:
starter:
func solve(text: String, letter: String) -> int:
	return 0
hint: Strings and arrays both have count; it takes the thing to look for.
solution:
func solve(text: String, letter: String) -> int:
	return text.count(letter)
